articles.summary: Citius Pharmaceuticals, Inc. ("Citius Pharma" or the "Company") (Nasdaq: CTXR), a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to the development and commercialization of first-in-class critical care products, today announced that Leonard Mazur, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, will participate in the Jefferies London Healthcare Conference, taking place November 16–19, 2026, in London, United Kingdom. Mr. Mazur will provide an overview of the Company's business and recent developments, including the ongoing commercialization of LYMPHIR ® (denileukin diftitox-cxdl) by the Company's majority-owned subsidiary, Citius Oncology, Inc. (Nasdaq: CTOR). Conference Details: Conference: Jefferies London Healthcare Conference Dates: November 16–19, 2026 Location: Waldorf Hilton ME Hotels, London, United Kingdom Format: one-on-one meetings One-on-one meetings with management may be scheduled by contacting a conference representative or the Company's investor relations team. About Citius
articles.title: Citius Pharmaceuticals to Participate in the Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference in London
